name: google-drive
description: Official Google Drive remote MCP server for searching, reading, and creating files in Drive. Google does not support automatic client registration, so you must provide your own OAuth client credentials: in the Google Cloud console, enable the Google Drive API and the Google Drive MCP API, create an OAuth client (web application), and add Devin's OAuth callback URL (https://api.devin.ai/mcp/oauth/callback, or the equivalent for your Devin environment) as an authorized redirect URI. Then enter the OAuth client ID and secret when installing this server.
